error[ZBX-E0821]: the fetched bytes do not match their pinned hash
  while  downloading the .fetch of build step "fetch"
  cause  the bytes downloaded are not those .sha256 pins
  cause  https://example.org/tool-1.2.tar.gz sent
         sha256:2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824
  step   fetch
  url    https://example.org/tool-1.2.tar.gz
  expect sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
  actual sha256:2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824
  fix    if .sha256 (or ADD --checksum) was copied wrongly, correct it; it pins sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
         otherwise find out why the file changed before trusting it
  more   zbx explain E0821
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0821.html
